visible_metrics: per-workload modeled mean power in mW
representative_rule: Common start plus lowest-Q new qualified candidate per workflow among terminal sessions, including worse-than-start new candidates.
browser_scope: Firefox visual inspection of the actual exported readout cell with original inline styles. Other cells and scripts were removed only in a temporary preview. This is section-level layout QA, not a full-page browser audit.
preview_correction: An initial full-page fragment capture did not scroll to the target; a temporary isolated preview first timed out because its profile directory was missing. The directory was created and the successful section capture replaced the preliminary image.
